series.name: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)
series.notes: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink table (airHome 300/400/500 service manuals, mirror at snowflakeaircon.sg). Model-scoped outdoor blink — separate from indoor timer LED. Medium-high.

title.en: No power supply to the outdoor board
title.ur: Outdoor board ko power supply nahi mil rahi

meaning.en: The LD301 indicator stays dark instead of blinking, which the source records as a no-power-supply condition rather than a coded fault.
meaning.ur: LD301 indicator blink karne ke bajaye band rehta hai, jise source ne coded fault ke bajaye no power supply ki halat likhi hai

causes.en: Mains supply absent at the outdoor unit — breaker tripped, fuse blown, or supply wiring open.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit par mains supply nahi hai — breaker trip ho chuka hai, fuse ura ho gaya hai, ya supply wiring khuli hai

causes.en: Loose supply terminal, failed outdoor PCB power section, or a protective device holding the board off.
causes.ur: Supply terminal dheela, outdoor PCB ka power section kharab, ya kisi protective device ki wajah se board off rehta hai

solutions.en: Check voltage at the outdoor terminals and at the incoming supply; reset the breaker/replace the fuse if open.
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminals aur aane wali supply par voltage check karein; breaker reset karein, agar fuse khula ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Repair supply wiring and tighten terminals; if voltage is present but the LED stays off, inspect the outdoor PCB power section.
solutions.ur: Supply wiring theek karein aur terminals kassain; voltage mojod ho uske bawajood LED off rahe to outdoor PCB ka power section dekhein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

notes.en: Source states airHome 300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH LD301 service manuals. PK sells airHome 200/200X/400 — confirm the model.
notes.ur: Source airHome 300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH LD301 service manuals se liya gaya hai. Pakistan mein airHome 200/200X/400 bikta hai — apna model confirm karein.

meaning.en: The outdoor board cut the compressor because the inrush/peak current limit was reached.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ne compressor rok diya kyunke inrush/peak current ki limit cross ho gayi

causes.en: Compressor inrush too high — weak run capacitor, poor supply, or compressor binding.
causes.ur: Compressor ka inrush zyada hai — run capacitor kamzor, supply kamzor, ya compressor jam kar na chalne ki wajah se

causes.en: Peak-current detection threshold disturbed by an outdoor PCB fault or wrong settings.
causes.ur: Peak current ki detection threshold outdoor PCB ki kharabi ya ghalat settings se bigad gayi

solutions.en: Check the run capacitor and supply voltage at the outdoor unit, and free the compressor if it is locked.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit par run capacitor aur supply voltage check karein, aur compressor locked ho to azad karein

solutions.en: Measure running current against nameplate; if current is normal, inspect the outdoor inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Chalta current ko nameplate se compare karke napen; current normal ho to outdoor inverter PCB check karein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

notes.en: Source wording: peak current cut in Wall-Mounted Split / Inverter Split / Single-Split rows.
notes.ur: Source ki wording yahan Wall-Mounted Split / Inverter Split / Single-Split rows mein 'peak current cut' hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 2 blinks, pause, repeat

title.ur: Low speed par ghoomne mein kharabi

meaning.en: The compressor or outdoor fan is not holding its minimum speed and the board cut operation.
meaning.ur: Compressor ya outdoor fan apni minimum speed par nahi rakh raha aur board ne operation rok diya

causes.en: Refrigerant undercharge/overcharge or a restriction producing abnormal running conditions.
causes.ur: Refrigerant km ya zyada charge, ya koi rokawat — in par run karne ki halat ghair mamooli ho jati hai

causes.en: Inverter drive or motor winding problem preventing stable low-speed operation.
causes.ur: Inverter drive ya motor winding ka masla, jis ki wajah se unit stable low speed par nahi chl pati

solutions.en: Check system pressures/charge and clean the condenser; verify the outdoor fan turns freely.
solutions.ur: System ke pressures aur charge check karein, condenser saaf karein; outdoor fan ki azaad rotation ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: If charge and airflow are correct, test the inverter drive and motor windings, replacing the faulty part.
solutions.ur: Charge aur airflow theek hon to inverter drive aur motor windings test karein aur kharab part badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 3 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: The inverter's power-switching stage reported a failure and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke power switching stage ne failure report ki aur unit band ho gaya

causes.en: Inverter/IGBT drive fault, damaged snubber or gate-drive components on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter drive fault, outdoor PCB par snubber ya driver ke parts kharab

causes.en: Loose DC-bus power connections or a shorted compressor winding stressing the switching stage.
causes.ur: DC bus ke power connections dheele ya compressor winding short ho jane se switching stage par load barh gaya

solutions.en: Inspect the outdoor inverter PCB for burnt drive components and check all power terminals for tightness.
solutions.ur: Outdoor inverter PCB par zale lagay huay drive components check karein aur tamam power terminals ki kash-shi check karein

solutions.en: Megger the compressor windings and replace the outdoor inverter PCB if the switching fault persists.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki windings ko megger se check karein aur agar switching kharabi bar bar aaye to outdoor inverter PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 4 blinks, pause, repeat

title.ur: Overload ki lower limit par cut

meaning.en: The overload protection cut in at its lower limit, i.e. the unit tripped on overload earlier than the normal setting would allow.
meaning.ur: Overload protection apni lower limit par hi cut ho gayi, yani unit normal setting se pehle hi overload par trip ho gayi

causes.en: High head pressure from a fouled condenser, blocked airflow or a condenser fan problem.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser, band airflow ya condenser fan ke masle se head pressure zyada ho gaya

causes.en: Overload protection settings/components out of spec, or an overcharged system.
causes.ur: Overload protection ki settings ya parts ghalat par hain, ya system mein refrigerant zyada charge hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, verify the outdoor fan runs at speed, and clear anything blocking airflow.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, outdoor fan ki poori speed verify karein, aur airflow rokne wali har cheez hatayein

solutions.en: Recover and weigh the refrigerant charge against nameplate; replace the overload device if it trips with normal current.
solutions.ur: Refrigerant charge nikal kar nameplate ke mutabiq waze kar ke tol lein; current normal hone par bhi overload device trip kare to use badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 5 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: Compressor temperature climbed above the allowed value and the board cut out.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki temperature allowed value se upar chali gayi aur board ne operation cut kar diya

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge, pipe clogging, or a failed discharge/pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam, pipe ka rakaav, ya discharge/pipe ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Poor heat rejection — dirty condenser, slow outdoor fan, or high ambient with blocked airflow.
causes.ur: Heat rejection kamzor — ganda condenser, slow outdoor fan, ya band airflow ke saath ambient temperature zyada

solutions.en: Leak-test, evacuate and recharge to specification; clean the condenser and confirm fan operation.
solutions.ur: Leak test karein, evacuate karke specification ke mutabiq recharge karein; condenser saaf karein aur fan ka kaam confirm karein

solutions.en: Measure the discharge/pipe thermistors and replace the one reading out of range.
solutions.ur: Discharge aur pipe ke thermistors ko naap lein, aur range se bahar reading wale ko badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

notes.en: Related to, but not the same scheme as, alarm code 08 (discharge-gas temperature) in the SET FREE series.
notes.ur: Yeh alarm code 08 (discharge-gas temperature, SET FREE series) se milta hai, lekin scheme bilkul woh nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 6 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: A thermistor used by the outdoor board is reading outside its valid range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board jo thermistor istemal karta hai wo apni valid range ke bilkul ulat parh raha hai

causes.en: Thermistor open-circuit or short-circuit from moisture, age or physical damage.
causes.ur: Nami, umar ya physical damage ki wajah se thermistor open-circuit ya short-circuit ho gaya

causes.en: Loose thermistor connector or damaged harness between sensor and board.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector dheela ya sensor aur board ke darmiyan harness kharab

solutions.en: Measure each outdoor thermistor against the service-manual resistance curve at known temperatures.
solutions.ur: Har outdoor thermistor ko maloom temperature par service manual ki resistance curve se compare kar ke napen

solutions.en: Refit or replace the out-of-range sensor; if all are in range, check the outdoor PCB input stage.
solutions.ur: Range se bahar reading wale sensor ko dobara lagayein ya badal dein; sab range mein hon to outdoor PCB ka input stage check karein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

notes.en: The source does not say which thermistor; identify by measuring all outdoor sensors.
notes.ur: Source mein nahi likha ke kaunsa thermistor hai; tamam outdoor sensors ko naap kar identify kar lein.

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 7 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: Signals between the outdoor board and the other unit/controller are not being received.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board aur doosre unit/controller ke darmiyan ka signal receive nahi ho raha

causes.en: Inter-unit or controller wiring open, short or loosely terminated.
causes.ur: Inter-unit ya controller ki wiring khuli, short ya dheele terminal se lagi hui hai

causes.en: Grounding/noise problem or a failed communication circuit on either PCB.
causes.ur: Grounding ya noise ka masla, ya kisi aik PCB ka communication circuit kharab

solutions.en: Check continuity and polarity of the communication wiring at both ends and re-terminate.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring ki continuity aur polarity dono saron par check karke dobara terminate karein

solutions.en: Keep communication cable away from power cable; if wiring is sound, replace the faulty PCB.
solutions.ur: Communication cable ko power cable se door rakhein; wiring theek nikle to kharab PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 9 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: The supply voltage seen by the outdoor board is outside the allowed window.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ko jo supply voltage mil rahi hai wo allowed range se door hai

causes.en: Local grid voltage too low/high, brownouts, or a wrongly sized supply.
causes.ur: Local grid voltage bohat kam ya zyada, voltage mein kami, ya supply ka size ghalat

causes.en: Loose supply terminals or a voltage-sense circuit fault on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Supply terminals dheele, ya outdoor PCB par voltage sensing circuit kharab

solutions.en: Measure voltage at the outdoor terminals during the fault and compare with the rating plate.
solutions.ur: Kharabi ke doran outdoor terminals par voltage nap kar rating plate se compare karein

solutions.en: Tighten terminals, correct the supply, and fit a stabiliser where the local supply swings.
solutions.ur: Terminals kass lein, supply theek karein, aur jahan local supply mein atar-chirah aati ho wahan stabiliser lagayein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

notes.en: Very common first check in Pakistan where supply voltage swings are frequent. A live Urdu/Hindi video covers 10-time blinking (youtube.com/watch?v=rxR3Ziq9MJ0) — procedure only, no separate table.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein supply voltage ki swings aam hain, is liye yeh sabse pehla check hai. Ek live Urdu/Hindi video 10-time blinking par hai (youtube.com/watch?v=rxR3Ziq9MJ0) — sirf procedure hai, alag table nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 10 blinks, pause, repeat

title.ur: Fan lock se fan ruk gaya

meaning.en: The outdoor fan is locked or not feedback-confirmed, so the board stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan locked hai ya feedback confirm nahi hua, is liye board ne unit rok di

causes.en: Fan blade obstructed, bearing seized, or fan motor winding failed.
causes.ur: Fan blade mein rakaav, bearing jam, ya fan motor ki winding kharab

causes.en: Fan motor connector loose or the outdoor PCB not driving the motor.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka connector dheela ya outdoor PCB motor ko drive nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Disconnect power, spin the fan by hand and clear any obstruction; replace a seized motor.
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karein, fan ko haath se ghumayein aur rakaav hatayein; motor jam ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Check the motor connector and windings; if the motor is good, check the outdoor PCB fan output.
solutions.ur: Motor ka connector aur windings check karein; motor theek ho to outdoor PCB ka fan output check karein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 12 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: The board could not read its stored configuration/parameters from the EEPROM.
meaning.ur: Board apne stored configuration/parameters ko EEPROM se parh nahi saka

causes.en: EEPROM data corrupted after a power interruption or an electrical transient.
causes.ur: Power break ya electrical transient ke baad EEPROM ka data kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Board replaced without writing the correct model parameters, or a failed EEPROM device.
causes.ur: Board tabbadla gaya magar sahi model parameters likhe gaye hi nahi, ya EEPROM device kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; if the error returns, re-program the board parameters for the model.
solutions.ur: Aik dafa power cycle karein; error wapas aaye to board ke parameters model ke mutabiq wapas program karein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the EEPROM cannot be re-read after reprogramming.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara program karne ke baad bhi EEPROM read na ho to outdoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 13 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage inside the inverter is outside its working range.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar DC bus ki voltage apne kaam ke range se bahar hai

causes.en: Rectifier, PFC or DC-link capacitor fault, or a supply sag feeding the DC bus.
causes.ur: Rectifier, PFC ya DC link capacitor kharab, ya supply kamzor hone se DC bus ki voltage gir gayi

causes.en: Overload pulling the DC bus down, or a short on the inverter output stage.
causes.ur: Overload ki wajah se DC bus ki voltage girna, ya inverter output stage par short

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus with the unit running and inspect the DC-link capacitors and rectifier.
solutions.ur: Unit ko chalate hue DC bus naapein aur DC-link capacitors aur rectifier ko check karein.

solutions.en: Check the mains supply feeding the board; replace the inverter PCB if the bus stays abnormal with good supply.
solutions.ur: Board ko chalane wali mains supply check karein; supply theek hone par bhi DC bus kharab rahe to inverter PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 14 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: A protection circuit on the outdoor board reported an abnormal condition; the source groups it under a generic circuit-abnormal state.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ka koi protection circuit abnormal condition report kar raha hai; source isay aam circuit abnormal state ke hisaab se report karta hai

causes.en: Protection circuit (overcurrent, undervoltage or thermal) tripping on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par protection circuit (overcurrent, undervoltage ya thermal) trip ho gaya

causes.en: Aged or damaged outdoor PCB with leakage in the detection network.
causes.ur: Purana ya kharab outdoor PCB, jis mein detection network ki leakage hai

solutions.en: Identify which protection input tripped per the model's service manual and correct that circuit's cause.
solutions.ur: Model ke service manual se dekhein ke kaunsa protection input trip hua hai, phir us circuit ki wajah theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the abnormal state repeats with all inputs normal.
solutions.ur: Agar tamam inputs theek hone par bhi kharabi baar baar aaye to outdoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

notes.en: Diagnostic note from the source: some models do not have a 15-blink state — confirm the model before diagnosing.
notes.ur: Source ka diagnostic note: kuch models mein 15-blink state hi nahi hoti — diagnosing se pehle model confirm karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 15 blinks, pause, repeat

title.ur: Band hone ke doran zyada load

meaning.en: The unit detected a high-load/high-pressure condition while it was supposed to be stopped.
meaning.ur: Unit ko band hona chahiye tha, phir bhi us ne zyada load/pressure ki halat detect kar li

causes.en: High standing pressure from non-condensables, overcharge, or a valve not seating while off.
causes.ur: Ghair mumine gas, zyada charge, ya band hone par valve theek se baith na jane ki wajah se standing pressure zyada hai

causes.en: Check valves/EEV leaking by, or the unit being restarted into a loaded circuit.
causes.ur: Check valve ya EEV se gas nikal rahi hai, ya loaded circuit mein unit dobara start kar di gayi

solutions.en: Record standing pressure with the unit off and compare with the specification.
solutions.ur: Unit band hone par standing pressure likhein aur specification se compare karein

solutions.en: Recover and recharge correctly, replace leaking check valves/EEV, and clear non-condensables.
solutions.ur: Gas wapas le kar sahi tareeqe se recharge karein, leak karne wale check valve/EEV badlein, aur non-condensable gasses nikaal dein

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 16 blinks, pause, repeat
